thread:
maria (Partnerships): Heads-up: AcmeEdge wants to list their Edge Gateway in the cloud marketplace for the July campaign. Theyre asking what security artifacts we require (SOC reports, pen test, questionnaire, SBOM) and how to coordinate the joint announcement. Can we align on artifacts + timeline?
akash (Eng-Sec): From sec side: SOC2 Type II attestation preferred, 3rd-party pen test report with remediation summary, firmware SBOM, signed firmware hashes, architecture diagrams (network and OTA flow), threat model, and a contact for scoping. We need the pen scope to include firmware update path and rollback protections.
sarah-ops: Marketplace intake deadline is 2026-07-10. Ops needs final artifacts by 2026-06-20 to allow redaction and review cycles. If SOC is still pending, we accept an interim SOC letter but it must be flagged on the listing.
maria (Partnerships): @dev-integration your note said pen scheduled in May. Can you confirm vendor, scope doc, and whether Redwood will witness? Also we need an integrator attestation for SI integration fields.
dev-integration: Confirmed vendor and slot: pen vendor booked 2026-05-18 -> 2026-05-22. Scope: network stack, management plane, firmware OTA path, and authentication flows. Vendor will produce draft findings by 2026-05-28. Redwood can send two remote observers. We'll upload draft to presigned S3 when ready.
kevin-sec: Add to checklist: vendor attestation (no conflict of interest), credential sanitation report, reproduction steps for critical findings (redacted as needed), and evidence of mitigations for high/critical issues. Also require SBOM and signed image hashes for firmware.
sarah-ops: Upload instructions: use the presign API and set TTL=30 days by default. Example: `curl -X POST https://artifact.redwood.ai/presign -d '{"name":"acmeedge_pen_report.pdf","ttl_days":30}'` Attach the `marketplace/compliance-templates.zip` when possible.
akash (Eng-Sec): For the pen report, request a one-page executive summary for marketplace reviewers and a separate technical appendix for sec-team. That lets us redact sensitive reproduction steps but preserve reviewer context.
maria (Partnerships): I'll draft the SI integrator attestation template today. Fields: integrator name, API scopes, data flows diagram link, justification for scopes, token lifetimes, and least-privilege statement.
dev-integration: Will upload two artifacts: `acmeedge_pen_report_draft.pdf` and `acmeedge_firmware_sbom.json.gz`. Any pre-upload redaction rules?
sarah-ops: Redact customer IPs and PII. If unsure, tag artifact as `sensitive` and ops will route to sec for redaction. We also enforce presign uploads to a restricted bucket with access audit.
kevin-sec: Propose quick review slot: 2026-05-26 10:00-10:30 PT for SecOps + Eng-Sec to go over draft findings. Need AcmeEdge rep and integrator present.
maria (Partnerships): I'll coordinate attendee list. After sec sign-off, marketing will run the joint announcement playbook; embargo window is normally 7 days. We need mutual sign-off on messaging and approved assets.
akash (Eng-Sec): Note: if SOC2 Type II isn't complete, marketplace can accept interim letter + control evidence, but listing must show status as "SOC2 in progress". If there are unresolved critical findings, we cannot proceed with the joint announcement until mitigations are verified.
dev-integration: AcmeEdge confirms SOC2 report expected 2026-06-15 and pen vendor will provide draft by 2026-05-28. We'll aim to have SBOM + signed images available with the draft.
sarah-ops: Action items summary: Maria -> integrator attestation matrix by EOD; Dev-Integration -> upload draft pen report to presign when available; Akash/Kevi -> review and give redaction/tech feedback by 2026-05-30; Ops -> prepare presign + TTL + redaction routing.
maria (Partnerships): I'll publish a short tracking doc with owners and dates after this meeting. Thanks everyone :+1:
marketplace-bot: Checklist: https://intranet.redwood.ai/marketplace/compliance-checklist and attach `marketplace/compliance-templates.zip` to presign.
